snippet.title: 荷物すら持たず山へ向かった4人家族の結末…2020年 稲村ヶ岳遭難事故【地形図とアニメで解説】
snippet.description:
2020年12月、奈良県・稲村ヶ岳。荷物すら持たずに4人家族が冬山へ向かい、遭難。
偶然居合わせた登山者の判断と行動が、凍えた家族の命を繋ぎます。
冬山の危険性と、救助者の証言を地形図とアニメーションで解説します。

◼︎参考資料：
YAMAP MAGAZINE（取材）
https://yamap.com/magazine/24582
YAMAP MAGAZINE（ご本人の投稿）
https://yamap.com/activities/9229997
読売新聞
https://www.yomiuri.co.jp/national/20210128-OYT1T50183/

en-US.title: The Tragic Fate of a Family of Four Who Climbed the Mountain Without Any Gear: The 2020 Inamuraga...
en-US.description:
In December 2020, on Mount Inamuragatake in Nara Prefecture, a family of four went into winter mountaineering without even carrying their belongings and became lost.

The judgment and actions of a fellow climber who happened to be there saved the lives of the frozen family.

This video explains the dangers of winter mountaineering and the rescuer's testimony using topographic maps and animation.

◼︎Reference Materials:
YAMAP MAGAZINE (Interview)
https://yamap.com/magazine/24582
YAMAP MAGAZINE (Personal Post)
https://yamap.com/activities/9229997
Yomiuri Shimbun
https://www.yomiuri.co.jp/national/20210128-OYT1T50183/
